ops.title: Reap stale CCPoolStatus.app serving domains.sock on an old binary after a cask upgrade
ops.description: Cask upgrades never recycle a live companion app: post-upgrade, the old CCPoolStatus.app process keeps serving domains.sock on the replaced binary (same class as the widget-appex whiteout fixed in v0.45.1, which only covers the WidgetKit appex). The daemon's fp.app.ensure row (v0.50.0) skips while the control socket answers, so a stale-but-alive app is never replaced. Reap should key on binary ctime vs process start like the appex reaper.

ops.text: daemon detects an app whose on-disk bundle is newer than the running process and bounces it under the same reconfirm-before-kill discipline
no bounce while FP domains are mid-enumeration or consent is pending
